    // TIGHT: the support of the ellipsoid along a world axis is
    // sqrt(sum over local axes of (semiAxis * axisImage.component)^2), because the
    // ellipsoid is the unit ball mapped by the (rotated, scaled) semi-axis frame.
    Bounds(e: Ellipsoid): Bounds3D
    {
        var b = e.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var a = e.SemiAxes;
        var ex = ((a.X * b.X.X).Square + (a.Y * b.Y.X).Square + (a.Z * b.Z.X).Square).Sqrt;
        var ey = ((a.X * b.X.Y).Square + (a.Y * b.Y.Y).Square + (a.Z * b.Z.Y).Square).Sqrt;
        var ez = ((a.X * b.X.Z).Square + (a.Y * b.Y.Z).Square + (a.Z * b.Z.Z).Square).Sqrt;
        return CenteredBounds(e.Center, ex, ey, ez);
    }

    // True when (x/a)^2 + (y/b)^2 + (z/c)^2 <= 1 in the ellipsoid's own frame.
    Contains(e: Ellipsoid, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var q = LocalOffset(e.Center, e.Orientation, point);
        return (q.X / e.SemiAxes.X).Square
            + (q.Y / e.SemiAxes.Y).Square
            + (q.Z / e.SemiAxes.Z).Square <= 1.0;
    }

    // The support point of an ellipsoid: in its own frame the point is
    // A^2 d / |A d| with A the diagonal semi-axis matrix, which is the image under
    // A of the unit-sphere support in the direction A d.
    Support(e: Ellipsoid, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var d = direction.Vector.Transform(e.Orientation.Inverse);
        var a = e.SemiAxes;
        var scaled = Vector3D(a.X * d.X, a.Y * d.Y, a.Z * d.Z);
        var local = Vector3D(a.X * scaled.X, a.Y * scaled.Y, a.Z * scaled.Z)
            / scaled.Magnitude;
        return e.Center + WorldOffset(e.Orientation, local);
    }

    // The circumscribed sphere of a box: centered at the box center with radius
    // half the Min -> Max diagonal length. Lives here rather than beside the other
    // Bounds3D bodies (foundation) because `Sphere` is a geometry type.
    BoundingSphere(self: Bounds3D): Sphere
        => (self.Center, self.Diagonal.Magnitude.Half);

    //==
    // # Torus bodies
    //
    // Volume, surface area, bounds, centroid and containment bodies for the type
    // declared in `spatial-primitives.types.plato`. Volume and surface area come from Pappus's
    // centroid theorem and are valid only for the non-self-intersecting ring torus. The
    // disk-extent helper, and the conventions governing every body here, are in the
    // shared section above.

    //==
    // # Torus
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus

    // 2 * pi^2 * R * r^2 — Pappus's centroid theorem applied to the minor disk swept
    // around the major circle. Valid only for the non-self-intersecting ring torus
    // (r <= R), which the declaration flags.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pappus%27s_centroid_theorem
    Volume(t: Torus): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi.Square * t.MajorRadius * t.MinorRadius.Square;

    // 4 * pi^2 * R * r — Pappus's theorem applied to the minor circle. Ring torus
    // only, as above.
    SurfaceArea(t: Torus): Number
        => 4.0 * Number.Pi.Square * t.MajorRadius * t.MinorRadius;

    // The stored centre, by the torus's rotational and mirror symmetry.
    Centroid(t: Torus): Point3D
        => t.Center;

    // TIGHT: the torus is the major circle Minkowski-summed with a ball of the minor
    // radius, so its support along a world axis is the circle's support
    // R*sqrt(1 - (axis.e)^2) plus r.
    Bounds(t: Torus): Bounds3D
    {
        var e = DiskHalfExtents(t.Axis.Vector, t.MajorRadius);
        return CenteredBounds(t.Center,
            e.X + t.MinorRadius, e.Y + t.MinorRadius, e.Z + t.MinorRadius);
    }

    // True when the query is within MinorRadius of the major circle: writing the
    // query in axial (t) and radial (d) cylindrical coordinates about the centre,
    // (d - R)^2 + t^2 <= r^2. Boundary inclusive.
    Contains(t: Torus, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = t.Center.Between(point);
        var axial = v.Dot(t.Axis.Vector);
        var radial = PerpendicularComponent(v, t.Axis.Vector).Magnitude;
        return (radial - t.MajorRadius).Square + axial.Square <= t.MinorRadius.Square;
    }
}
